pages.content:
# 🔥🔥🔥[MOSEv2: A More Challenging Dataset for Video Object Segmentation in Complex Scenes](https://mose.video/)🔥🔥🔥

## Download (Training set and validation set)
⬇️ Get the dataset from:

- 🤗 [Hugging Face](https://huggingface.co/datasets/FudanCVL/MOSEv2)
- ☁️ [Google Drive](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1tb6duuZPrjfuHVvJLcWXItsqde3fup4n?usp=drive_link)
- ☁️ [OneDrive](https://1drv.ms/f/c/c2b61e01a0e33ea5/EjSXr6Erm5BCuj_fj3Bw6ncBLfOqrGwmvYX1eNnhf2qWog?e=E2R8on) 
- ☁️ [Baidu Pan](https://pan.baidu.com/s/1QWzovOubI0Uvr2gEQChy7Q?pwd=p2m6) (pwd: p2m6)



## Download (Training set and validation set)

```shell
# train.tar.gz
gdown 'https://drive.google.com/uc?id=ID_removed_to_avoid_overaccesses_get_it_by_yourself'

# valid.tar.gz
gdown 'https://drive.google.com/uc?id=ID_removed_to_avoid_overaccesses_get_it_by_yourself'

# test set will be released when competition starts.
```


## Submission
The submission file should be a **.zip** pack contains the results on all videos. Like DAVIS2017, video folders should be put in the **root directory** of the zip. Make sure the filenames of the predicted frames match the filenames of the image frames.

Please check the sample submission in the download link for reference.
```
<submission.zip>
│ 
├── <video_name_1>
│ ├── 00000.png
│ ├── 00001.png
│ └── ...
│ 
├── <video_name_2>
│ ├── 00000.png
│ ├── 00001.png
│ └── ...
│ 
└── <video_name_...>
```

# Evaluation
We evaluate performance using multiple metrics: the Jaccard index (J), F-Measure (F), their mean (J&F), an improved F-Measure (Ḟ), and the mean of J and F_new (J&Ḟ). To better assess the complex scenarios in MOSEv2 where objects frequently disappear and reappear, we also report specialized metrics: J&Ḟ_disappear and J&Ḟ_reappear.

**Note**: Ḟ adaptively computes boundary thresholds based on object size, providing fairer evaluation of boundary prediction quality across objects of different scales. For more information, please refer to the paper.

*The evaluation may take 20 minutes to finish because of the data size. If your submussion exceed the time limit (20min) during scoring, please check if your data meets the requirements and view your log. If the issue persists, please contact us~*
